items.title: All 43 completed 2026-27 games are present in the three core game feeds

source.label: Local NBA game stores
caveats: Coverage establishes that each completed game is stored; it does not establish that downstream training tables have been rebuilt from those rows.

preview.note: Aggregate reconciliation by normalized NBA game ID.

evidenceFlow.title: Game-ID reconciliation
evidenceFlow.text: Normalized game IDs from the team and play-by-play stores were compared with the 43 distinct IDs in the player box-score store; neither source was missing a game.

items.title: Raw game capture is current, but training and layer-feature consumption are not fully current

source.label: Training and projection tables
caveats: Early-season minimum-game rules make some live-layer sparsity expected, especially the luck layer; missing values should not be fabricated.

evidenceFlow.title: Production feature use
evidenceFlow.text: The production selected-feature manifest contains no historical PBP, season-PPP, blowout, usage-profile, or luck-layer fields for seven of nine prop models; STL selects point-in-time opponent defense and BLK selects point-in-time opponent pace.

items.title: Collection is manual and current-season FanDuel history begins only on October 26

source.label: Operator workflow and local market store
caveats: A FanDuel snapshot is recorded only when the workflow is run; one snapshot does not measure T-60-to-T-5 movement.

preview.note: Local scheduled-task check and current-season market-store profile.

evidenceFlow.title: Workflow behavior
evidenceFlow.text: PicksNow passes both --skip-layers and --skip-weekly-retrain. DailySafe refreshes live layers but also passes --skip-weekly-retrain. No matching Windows scheduled task is installed.
